items.name: utils
items.title: Utilities
items.description: cn() helper - merges Tailwind classes with clsx + tailwind-merge.

items.name: govuk-tokens
items.title: Whitehall-UI Tokens
items.description: Whitehall-UI theme tokens (based on GOV.UK Design System) – colours, typography, spacing, shadows. Import in your CSS entry point after @import 'tailwindcss'.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Whitehall-UI button (based on GOV.UK Design System) with default, secondary, warning, inverse and start variants.

items.name: text-input
items.title: Text Input
items.description: Whitehall-UI text input (based on GOV.UK Design System) with fixed-width and fluid-width variants, error state and extra letter spacing for codes.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Whitehall-UI textarea (based on GOV.UK Design System) for multi-line text input with error state and WCAG 2.2 accessibility.

items.name: tag
items.title: Tag
items.description: Whitehall-UI tag (based on GOV.UK Design System) with 9 colour variants for showing status indicators.

items.name: inset-text
items.title: Inset Text
items.description: Whitehall-UI inset text (based on GOV.UK Design System) for differentiating a block of text from surrounding content.

items.name: radios
items.title: Radios
items.description: Whitehall-UI radios (based on GOV.UK Design System) for letting users select one option from a list, with hint text and divider support.

items.name: checkboxes
items.title: Checkboxes
items.description: Whitehall-UI checkboxes (based on GOV.UK Design System) for letting users select one or more options from a list, with hint text and divider support.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Whitehall-UI select (based on GOV.UK Design System) for choosing an option from a dropdown list, with error state support.

items.name: fieldset
items.title: Fieldset
items.description: Whitehall-UI fieldset component (based on GOV.UK Design System) for grouping related form inputs with legend heading support.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Whitehall-UI label component for form inputs with size variants matching GOV.UK typography scale.

items.name: hint
items.title: Hint
items.description: Whitehall-UI hint component for displaying help text below labels in form groups.

items.name: error-message
items.title: Error Message
items.description: Whitehall-UI error message component for showing validation errors next to form fields, with a visually hidden prefix for screen readers.

items.name: error-summary
items.title: Error Summary
items.description: Whitehall-UI error summary component for summarising validation errors at the top of a page, with linked error messages.

items.name: footer
items.title: Footer
items.description: Whitehall-UI footer component. Provides copyright, licensing, secondary navigation and meta links at the bottom of every page.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: Whitehall-UI link component (based on GOV.UK Design System) with default, muted, inverse, no-underline and no-visited-state variants.

items.name: back-link
items.title: Back Link
items.description: Whitehall-UI back link component (based on GOV.UK Design System) for navigating back in multi-page transactions. Supports inverse variant for dark backgrounds.

items.name: skip-link
items.title: Skip Link
items.description: Whitehall-UI skip link component (based on GOV.UK Design System) for keyboard-only users to skip navigation and jump to main content. Visually hidden until focused.

items.name: panel
items.title: Panel
items.description: Whitehall-UI panel component (based on GOV.UK Design System) for confirmation pages. Displays a green banner with title and optional reference number.

items.name: header
items.title: Header
items.description: Whitehall-UI header component. A composable masthead bar for branding, with sub-components for container, logo area, link and product name.

items.name: warning-text
items.title: Warning Text
items.description: Whitehall-UI warning text component (based on GOV.UK Design System) for warning users about important consequences, with an exclamation icon and visually hidden assistive prefix.

items.name: notification-banner
items.title: Notification Banner
items.description: Whitehall-UI notification banner component (based on GOV.UK Design System) for important messages at the top of a page. Supports default (blue) and success (green) variants.

items.name: phase-banner
items.title: Phase Banner
items.description: Whitehall-UI phase banner component (based on GOV.UK Design System) for showing users your service is in alpha or beta phase.

items.name: details
items.title: Details
items.description: Whitehall-UI details component (based on GOV.UK Design System) for letting users reveal more detailed information only if they need it. Built on Base UI Collapsible.

items.name: summary-list
items.title: Summary List
items.description: Whitehall-UI summary list component (based on GOV.UK Design System) for displaying key-value pairs. Includes summary card variant for grouping multiple lists.

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: Whitehall-UI breadcrumbs component (based on GOV.UK Design System) for helping users understand where they are in a website's structure. Supports collapse on mobile and inverse variants.

items.name: task-list
items.title: Task List
items.description: Whitehall-UI task list component (based on GOV.UK Design System) for displaying tasks a user needs to complete, with status indicators and clickable rows.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Whitehall-UI tabs component (based on GOV.UK Design System) for navigating between related sections of content, displaying one section at a time.
